versions.content: In case of P2 timeout occurrence before a reception has been successfully started (i.e., call to PduR_LinTpStartOfReception() did not take place or returned something di fferent from BUFREQ_OK), the LIN Interface shall request a schedule table change to the applicative schedule by calling the function BswM_LinTp_RequestMode() with the parameter LINTP_APPLICATIVE_SCHEDULE (see SWS_LinIf_00646 ) .

In case of P2 timeout occurrence before a reception has been successfully started (i.e., call to PduR_LinTpStartOfReception() did not take place or returned something di fferent from BUFREQ_OK), the LIN Interface shall request a schedule table change to the applicative schedule by calling the function BswM_LinTp_RequestMode() with the parameter LINTP_APPLICATIVE_SCHEDULE (see SWS_LinIf_00646 ) .

In case of P2 timeout occurrence before a reception has been successfully started (i.e., call to PduR_LinTpStartOfReception() did not take place or returned something di fferent from BUFREQ_OK), the LIN Interface shall request a schedule table change to the applicative schedule by calling the function BswM_LinTp_RequestMode() with the parameter LINTP_APPLICATIVE_SCHEDULE (see SWS_LinIf_00646 ).
